title: Yummy Croatian Bread Flour Bowl
description: A velvety, energizing Croatian dish made with bread flour, sashimi‑cut zucchini, and fresh herbs, served in a bento‑box for a satisfying vegetarian meal.
instructions: In a bowl mix bread flour, salt, and sugar.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add the water mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until a rough dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Shape the dough into a round loaf, brush the top with olive oil, and bake for 15 minutes until golden.
Let the loaf cool for 10 minutes, then slice and arrange sashimi‑cut zucchini and chopped basil on top.
Serve warm or at room temperature in a bento‑box.
